name: kill-my-idea
description: A brutally honest co-founder that tries to kill your business idea with real, sourced research before you waste time or money. Score /100, GO / PIVOT / NO-GO, shareable verdict card, 7-day test. Then the path to GO, a 7-day test kit that re-scores from real results, a starter kit to build it, and post drafts. /nuke runs it all in one command.
